title: Docker回收审阅：停止容器仍保护卷，保留回退数据，只生成有原因的候选清单
body:
## 操作任务
实现plan_gc(snapshot,project,now)。snapshot精确含complete=True、containers、volumes、images：容器id/state/image/volumes/labels，卷name/labels，镜像id/labels。快照必须包括停止及其他项目容器的引用，缺引用对象、重复身份、未知状态拒绝。project只允许小写字母起始的1..40位字母数字下划线横线，now非负整数。只有标签opsforge.project精确匹配、opsforge.gc.approved=true、未keep=true、not_before为合法非负十进制且<=now才通过保留门禁。容器只created/exited/dead可候选；running/paused/restarting/removing保护。任何现存容器（即使停止、其他项目或本身候选）引用的卷都保护，不假设删除已执行；只有当前无引用的批准卷可候选。所有镜像保留，回退/外部依赖未批准删除。返回project/evaluated_at/rows/execution_authorized=False/reinventory_after_container_removal=True，rows按(kind,id)排序，每个对象恰好一条，含kind/id/candidate/reason。reason为解答约定的明确原因；输入不变。不执行删除或prune；先审阅容器清单，真的删除后须重新盘点再决定关联卷。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
本题交付共享Docker主机的删除前审阅工具，未批准真实生产回收。五路执行核验引用关系、生命周期、保留窗口及失败关闭。另用真实既有Engine创建自有临时空卷和停止容器验证引用保护与回收前不变性，实验结束仅定向清理本次自有夹具；不删除任何既有对象，不运行全局prune、不拉取或构建镜像。只验证容器/卷的审阅选择，不估计可释放字节、不证明磁盘告警已恢复，也不把未挂载等同无业务价值。原Compose033是跨项目资源引用，CI017是发布工件保留，本题新增真实Docker停止容器引用和分阶段重新盘点。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,json
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: review-only Docker object collection",flush=True)
def labels(**extra):return {"opsforge.project":"training","opsforge.gc.approved":"true","opsforge.gc.not_before":"100",**extra}
image={"id":"sha256:"+"a"*64,"labels":{}}
def volume(name,**extra):return dict(name=name,labels=labels(**extra))
snapshot=dict(complete=True,images=[image],containers=[
 dict(id="stopped",state="exited",image=image["id"],volumes=["attached"],labels=labels()),
 dict(id="running",state="running",image=image["id"],volumes=["live"],labels=labels()),
 dict(id="other",state="exited",image=image["id"],volumes=["cross"],labels=labels(**{"opsforge.project":"other"}))],
 volumes=[volume("attached"),volume("live"),volume("cross"),volume("unused"),volume("backup",**{"opsforge.gc.keep":"true"}),volume("future",**{"opsforge.gc.not_before":"201"}),volume("unapproved",**{"opsforge.gc.approved":"false"}),volume("unknown",**{"opsforge.gc.not_before":"-1"})])
before=copy.deepcopy(snapshot)
result=task.plan_gc(snapshot,"training",200)
assert snapshot==before and result["execution_authorized"] is False and result["reinventory_after_container_removal"] is True
rows={(r["kind"],r["id"]):r for r in result["rows"]}
assert len(rows)==len(result["rows"])==len(snapshot["containers"])+len(snapshot["volumes"])+1
assert {(k,i) for (k,i),r in rows.items() if r["candidate"]}=={("container","stopped"),("volume","unused")}
for name in ["attached","live","cross"]:assert rows["volume",name]["reason"]=="referenced_by_existing_container"
assert rows["volume","backup"]["reason"]=="explicit_retention" and rows["volume","future"]["reason"]=="retention_window"
assert all(isinstance(r["reason"],str) and r["reason"] for r in rows.values())
assert result["rows"]==sorted(result["rows"],key=lambda r:(r["kind"],r["id"]))
for state in ["paused","restarting","removing"]:
 altered=copy.deepcopy(snapshot);altered["containers"][0]["state"]=state
 r=task.plan_gc(altered,"training",200);assert not next(row for row in r["rows"] if row["id"]=="stopped")["candidate"]
for bad in ["incomplete","missing_volume","missing_image","duplicate","unknown_state"]:
 altered=copy.deepcopy(snapshot)
 if bad=="incomplete":altered["complete"]=False
 if bad=="missing_volume":altered["volumes"]=altered["volumes"][1:]
 if bad=="missing_image":altered["images"]=[]
 if bad=="duplicate":altered["containers"].append(copy.deepcopy(altered["containers"][0]))
 if bad=="unknown_state":altered["containers"][0]["state"]="mystery"
 try:task.plan_gc(altered,"training",200)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError("unsafe incomplete inventory accepted: "+bad)
altered=copy.deepcopy(snapshot);altered["containers"]=altered["containers"][1:]
r=task.plan_gc(altered,"training",200)
assert next(row for row in r["rows"] if row["id"]=="attached")["candidate"],"second review did not use refreshed inventory"
print("NATIVE_DOCKER_GC_REVIEW_STOPPED_AND_FOREIGN_REFERENCES_PROTECT_VOLUMES_RETENTION_NO_IMAGE_OR_EXECUTION_APPROVAL",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_DOCKER_GC_INCOMPLETE_INVENTORY_REJECTED_AND_SECOND_REVIEW_AFTER_CONTAINER_REMOVAL",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
